name: Modulo Pi Modulo Player
notes: Complete list: 23 actions (src/actions.ts, one setActionDefinitions call in UpdateActions) and 9 feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts, UpdateFeedbacks). Both are re-registered whenever the playlist or task list changes (updateInstance), so the dropdown lists are fresh snapshots of the device state.

Protocol: WebSocket / JSON-RPC to Modulo Player (config mpPort, default 8080) and optionally to the Spydog monitoring daemon (sdPort default 8081, sdEnable default true); host has Regex.IP and no default; pollInterval default 1000 ms (min 0, max 60000; 0 = off) in src/configFields.ts. Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Options with visibleWhen "false" (source isVisibleExpression: 'false') are hidden in the UI but remain real options of the entity (launch_task task, cueUUID and plUUID of the playlist actions, the uuid/pl/cue/current_Cue/master options of the feedbacks). The presets address tasks through the dropdown tl and playlists through plUUID/pl (src/presets.ts); the upgrade script src/upgrades.ts copies the legacy task and uuid options into tl and cue.

Playlist selection: resolvePlaylistUuid (src/actions.ts:3) first looks up the option pl as a dropdown id, then as a legacy numeric index, then uses plUUID when not empty. For goto_cue and preload_cue the hidden cueUUID wins over the number index; when cueUUID is empty the index (1-based, min 1, max 10000) is sent as given.

The *_add and *_remove actions keep the fader state in the module (variable pl_<uuid>_grandMasterFader / _audioMaster), add or subtract value percent and clamp at 100 or 0 and send it with duration 0. The remove actions grand_master_fader_remove and audio_master_remove have different defaults (1 and 100) in the source; recorded as written.

The feedbacks status (dropdown with number ids 0, 1, 2) and master (number) compare with strict equality against the stored state, so number ids matter. current_Cue compares a string against a cue index found by uuid, or a numeric option against the playlist current index.
Spydog actions (spydog_*) only do something when the Spydog connection is enabled and reachable.
Boolean feedback default styles (defaultStyle in the source) are not part of the catalog schema and are not recorded.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.12.1: options do not support expressions.

options.label: Select Task
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the tasks reported by Modulo Player (src/moduloplayer.ts:63-69): id = task uuid without braces, label = task name. Empty until the list arrives; the source default is the first task id or ''. If the id is not found the callback falls back to the hidden option task.

options.label: Cue ID (used only if Cue UUID is empty)
Select Playlist
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the playlists reported by Modulo Player (src/moduloplayer.ts:84-89, rebuilt through updateInstance): id = playlist uuid without braces ({ and } removed by cleanUUID, src/main.ts:193), label = playlist name. Before the first list arrives the list is empty. The default '0' is not a playlist id; the callback treats a string that is not a known id but parses as an integer as a legacy index into the playlist list (src/actions.ts:3-13), otherwise falls back to plUUID.

feedbacks.name: Color Task
feedbacks.description: Sets the button background to the task color. Reads the variable tl_<uuid>_color, uuid is the option text as written (no brace stripping in the callback).

feedbacks.name: Color Cue
feedbacks.description: Sets the button background to the cue color (variable cue_<id>_color). The callback uses the option cue when it is not empty, otherwise the legacy uuid; pl is not used by the callback.

feedbacks.name: FPS Player
feedbacks.description: Green background when the variable fpsOk is truthy, red otherwise.

feedbacks.name: Memory Use
feedbacks.description: Background from the variable memoryUse: green below 50, orange from 50 to 90, red otherwise (also when not a number).

feedbacks.name: CPU Use
feedbacks.description: Background from the variable cpuUse: green below 50, orange from 50 to 90, red otherwise (also when not a number).
